item.title: MeitY’s Tech Mandate: 50 Lakh+ Platforms Must Auto-Remove Obscene Content or Face Prosecution Amid 25 OTT Blocks
item.description: MeitY's Dec 29 advisory: Platforms over 50 lakh users must AI-remove obscene content amid screening gaps, SC push.

item.title: Bangladesh Leader Osman Hadi Murder: Prime Accused Faisal Karim Masud Denies Role from Dubai, Blames Jamaat-Shibir
item.description: A Dubai video denial, disputed India escape claims, and political rivalries complicate the probe into Osman Hadi’s killing.

item.title: Iran Economic Protests Kill Six Including Child, Spread Nationwide Amid Rial Crash and Subsidy Anger
item.description: Iran protests over inflation, subsidy cuts turn deadly: 6 killed; Pezeshkian vows reforms, dialogue.

item.title: Delhi Court Orders Husband to Pay ₹5 Lakh Monthly Maintenance to Wife After 13 Months of Marriage, Citing Dignified Living
item.description: A Delhi family court awards Rs 5 lakh interim maintenance to an educated wife, stressing dignified living over earning potential despite a 13-month marriage.

item.title: Indore Water Crisis: Nine Dead as Sewage-Contaminated Water Sickens Hundreds; Officials Dismissed, Probe On
item.description: Indore Water Crisis: A devastating sewage leak in Indore’s water supply has claimed ten lives and hospitalised hundreds recently.

item.title: ‘We Are Thinking of You’: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani Writes to Jailed Activist Umar Khalid, Letter Sparks Global Attention
item.description: In a viral handwritten note, New York City's first Muslim mayor Zohran Mamdani expresses support for Delhi riots accused Umar Khalid after 4.5 years in jail, reigniting calls for justice.

item.title: Switzerland Bar Fire: About 40 Killed, 115 Injured as New Year’s Celebration Turns Fatal at Swiss Alpine Resort
item.description: A New Year’s fire in Crans-Montana has left forty people dead and scores seriously injured in Switzerland .

item.title: Shariatpur Horror: 50yo Hindu Trader Hacked, Petrol-Doused & Burnt by Recognised Attackers in Bangladesh
item.description: Hindu businessman survives stabbing, fiery assault in Bangladesh's Shariatpur after recognising attackers amid minority violence.

item.title: ‘Petrol Ke Paise Ho Gaye’: Delivery Executive’s Emotional Reply After Customer Tips Him ₹501 on New Year’s Eve Goes Viral
item.description: A heartwarming exchange on New Year's Eve saw a delivery rider’s commitment met with a generous tip.

item.title: Double Tragedy in Wayanad: Woman Dies in Alleged Suicide Weeks After Husband’s Death in Israel, Investigation Underway
item.description: A grieving Wayanad woman died after an alleged suicide attempt weeks after her husband’s death in Israel.
